t: This LAP 1G switched socket integrates dual Type A and Type C USB ports to power appliances and charge mobile devices simultaneously. This durable white moulded plastic socket is ideal for busy domestic properties and commercial offices, offering a practical solution for electricians during retrofits or new installations. Backed-out captive terminal screws simplify installation within a standard 25mm back box. The unit delivers an 18W output, automatically optimising power delivery for smartphones and tablets while keeping the main outlet free for heavy-duty tools or household appliances.
